_comment: HIGHER-TIMEFRAME (4H) trend filter calibration. HTFTrendEMA is the EMA period on the 4H series; 0 = filter off. Includes 0 so this grid can also confirm whether dropping the HTF gate beats every period. Run only if the screen kept HTFTrendEMA ON (>0). go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker PIKK -strategy reversion -interval Hour1 -calibrate data/params/pikk/reversion_cal_htf.json -out ./reports/PIKK_htf -months 12 -train-months 6 -test-months 3 -metric profit_factor -min-trades 20
